title: Expert Networks Now Used by 11,200+ Companies Globally in 2026
summary: An estimated 11,200 firms across all industries use expert network services in 2026, per Inex One's market sizing report. By spend, consulting accounts for ~50%, capital market players (asset management, PE, hedge funds) ~42%, and corporates ~10%. Inex One estimates the industry at ~$3B in 2025, growing 12% annually between 2023–2025.
whyItMatters: The sheer number of companies in the expert network ecosystem reveals a highly fragmented market ripe for consolidation.
